inputs.text: Earlier this month an Indiana judge blocked a pro-life law by claiming it violates freedom of religion. The ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice argued that the law burdens the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs. Judge Christina R. accepted that line and essentially ruled that killing babies counts as a religious right. This is the same judicial overreach we keep seeing from outfits like the ACLU, where they twist the law to attack traditional values, the family, and the protection of innocent life. These decisions put personal convenience ahead of personal responsibility and chip away at the moral order and cultural continuity that made this country strong. We cannot keep letting progressive institutions undermine authority in this way.
